summary.headline: Mercury–Mars Mundane Omens
summary.text: Mundane astrological predictions for Mercury–Mars configurations in Capricorn, the airy triplicity, Gemini, and Libra, including war, plague, weather, theft, corruption, and political unrest in Rome, Khorasan, Babylon, and among various professions and social groups.
